unresolved_issues.description: Top monitor reflection extraction subtracts E_inc only (exp(-ik0*z_top)), but for the layered-background formulation the background at the top monitor includes both the incident wave AND the flat-interface reflected background r_eff*exp(+ik1*z_top). Subtracting only E_inc gives wrong r_m amplitudes. The modal_data_loss function correctly subtracts only r_eff*exp(+ik1*z) (the reflected BG) but extract_modal_amplitudes does not.
unresolved_issues.impact: r_m amplitudes extracted from PINN total field are systematically wrong

unresolved_issues.description: All 2D grating runs show R+T << 1 (0.47–0.62). P_inc=0.5 is used as a normalisation factor, so the raw R_total+T_total values of ~0.49 imply an apparent efficiency of ~0.98, which is close to 1.0 — but the individual R0 and T0 values do not match RCWA references (RCWA: R0=0.0217, T0_eff=0.818; PINN: R0~0.16, T0~0.33). Modal power distribution is wrong.
unresolved_issues.impact: PINN does not recover correct modal reflection/transmission

unresolved_issues.description: Complex-field L2 errors are 47–60% across all 2D runs. Phase RMSE is 31–48 degrees. These errors are inconsistent with a physically correct solution and indicate the PINN is not converging to the correct field.

unresolved_issues.component: modal_dtn_loss — Robin vs DtN boundary selection
unresolved_issues.description: The training scripts use Robin BCs (H=±n*E) by default, which is only exact for the m=0 normal-incidence mode. For lambda=0.8 with propagating ±1 orders in the substrate, the Robin BC introduces systematic errors. DtN is implemented but not the default.
unresolved_issues.impact: Boundary condition errors pollute the ±1 transmitted orders

unresolved_issues.description: No standalone reference-only test exists that passes RCWA fields directly through the modal extractor and asserts correct recovery of stored r_m and t_m amplitudes without any PINN involved. Phase 1 requires implementing and passing this test.
unresolved_issues.impact: Cannot confirm modal extractor is correct before PINN training
unresolved_issues.fix_required_before: Phase 1 gate (must pass before any new training)
unresolved_issues.resolution: scripts/verify_modal_extractor.py implemented and passes 43/43 assertions. Field reconstruction, de-embedding, total/scattered extraction, modal amplitude and phase, and energy balance all verified.

scattered_field_extraction.note: R_scat+T_scat != 1 by design: scattered field carries only grating-scattered power (~0.19 total). Background carries the rest (~0.978). Energy is only meaningful for the total field.

critical_issue_confirmed_ISSUE01.description: extract_modal_amplitudes in field_comparison.py subtracts only E_inc at the top monitor. For layered-bg PINN evaluation, the correct subtraction is E_inc + r_eff*exp(+ik1*z_top) (the full background). This will cause incorrect r_m values when extracting from PINN total field. The modal_data_loss function already handles this correctly. MUST be fixed before Phase 5 PINN validation.
critical_issue_confirmed_ISSUE01.impact: PINN r0 extraction overestimates by reflected background component

new_finding_grating_interior.description: The NPZ does not store grating-layer eigenmodes. Reconstruction of E_total inside the grating region (1.2 < z < 1.4) from stored c_refl/c_trans alone is not possible without eigenmode data. Monitor planes must remain in z <= 1.2 (air) or z >= 1.4 (substrate). Current monitor positions (z_top=0.157, z_bot=1.843) are both in valid regions.
new_finding_grating_interior.impact: roundtrip reconstruction valid only outside grating interior
